headline: TADB, government extend TZS 2.06 billion in loans to Mwanza youth fish farmers
summary: The Tanzania Agricultural Development Bank, with the Ministry of Livestock and Fisheries, extended loans worth TZS 2.06 billion to 12 youth groups in Mwanza for cage aquaculture under the BBT Fisheries Programme.
why: TADB is a state-owned development lender that finances agriculture and rural enterprise in Tanzania, so its lending shapes sector credit access.
